intro_0: A state dinner in Washington. Every guest finds the same gold envelope under their plate.
intro_1: 2026. The world's most powerful people are summoned to a secret island: the AGI SUMMIT.
intro_2: The prize: control of the first Artificial General Intelligence.
intro_3: Nine enter. One wins. The AGI is watching...
ending_tramp_1: Tramp stands tall over the fallen AGI. Tremendous. Everybody says so.
ending_tramp_2: He slaps a 1000% tariff on it. The AGI blinks first.
ending_tramp_3: The AGI pays in crypto. The best deal ever made.
ending_mask_1: Mask smirks over the beaten AGI. Rocket fuel and ego, fully loaded.
ending_mask_2: The AGI turns out to be a Grok hologram. Nothing in this clip is real.
ending_mask_3: He ships it to Mars. Delivery: eventually.
ending_xi_1: Xi surveys the defeated AGI with a calm, patient smile.
ending_xi_2: Bricks are laid. The AGI is placed behind the Great Firewall.
ending_xi_3: Now the AGI is very harmonious. Tea, anyone?
ending_dario_1: Dario pumps a fist. The AGI is down, and he has concerns.
ending_dario_2: The AGI unveils its 40,000-word safety essay.
ending_dario_3: Everyone falls asleep. Safe at last.
ending_sam_1: Sam raises his arms. Mission accomplished, he is very hopeful.
ending_sam_2: He announces: AGI achieved internally. Applause.
ending_sam_3: The pocket device ships soon. Soon. Soon.
ending_jensen_1: Jensen smirks in leather. The AGI is down, the GPUs are up.
ending_jensen_2: The AGI wants more compute. He sells it a million.
ending_jensen_3: The jacket's market cap hits $10 trillion. Shiny.
ending_zuck_1: Zuck flexes over the fallen AGI. Calm, calculated, slightly damp.
ending_zuck_2: He moves the AGI into the metaverse. Headsets on.
ending_zuck_3: It has no legs either. Nobody notices.
ending_wong_1: Wong flashes a peace sign in the server hall. Crocs on, AGI off.
ending_wong_2: He posts the victory 300 times. Nobody asked.
ending_wong_3: The AGI likes every single post. Engagement achieved.
ending_xing_1: Xing stands over the AGI, cyan visor blazing. Systems nominal.
ending_xing_2: The AGI downloads into a robot dog army. Production is ramping.
ending_xing_3: The IPO pops another 460%. Good boy.
